title: Metrics or Mirage? An Audit of Evaluation Inconsistencies in Colonoscopy Polyp Segmentation Benchmarks
mechanism: Audit of a sub-field's evaluation: incompatible split protocols, missing boundary metrics and significance tests; controlled re-evaluation shows ranking reversals; reporting checklist.
adaptation: Same audit for EL segmentation papers (splits, releases, class lists, metrics, tolerance, test size, tests) to back the 'unorganised field' claim.
min_experiment: Arm: audit table from D01-D03 paper lists. Kill: none.
evidence: R: 27 papers; 5 incompatible split protocols on Kvasir-SEG/CVC-ClinicDB; 26 of 27 without significance tests; near-tied rankings reverse across random splits.
